text:
Ali: Customer BrightWave reporting 403 in project console after a recent Okta SCIM sync. Edit buttons are disabled, view works. Can someone triage?

Maria: Saw the ticket. They mention they ran a bulk SCIM group rename (Engineers -> engineers) about 2h before the issue. UI shows project actions but buttons are greyed, 403 on write API calls.

Sam: Thanks. Can you paste the console API response body (when a user clicks an Edit button) and any relevant request headers? Also were there any deploys to auth/identity in the last 24h?

Ali: Pasted example from their browser (curl reproduction):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/brightwave-123/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_customer_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"patch": {"name": "new"}}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing_role_binding","required":"project.admin","binding_external_id":"Engineers"}
```

Sam: That error (binding_external_id = "Engineers") is the smoking gun. Our RBAC lookup uses the group external_id provided by SCIM; Okta apparently normalized the group name to lower-case during the recent bulk rename. If the identity provider changes group external_id casing, existing bindings won't resolve.

Priya: I'm checking the RBAC store now. Running quick query to show bindings for org brightwave-123:
```
-- psql -c "select external_id, role, subject_type from role_bindings where org_id='brightwave-123';"
 external_id |    role     | subject_type
-------------+-------------+-------------
 Engineers   | project.admin | group
 billing     | billing.admin | group
```
Looks like bindings still point to "Engineers" (capital E). Okta sync log shows new group id as "engineers".

okta-sync-bot: Full SCIM sync completed 2026-03-10T12:02:00Z. Normalized group names to lower case by default during bulk rename. Items processed: 420 groups.

Sam: Root cause confirmed: case mismatch between stored binding external_id and Okta's new external_id. Two remediation paths:
- Short term: customer can rebind role to the new external_id via Admin Console (Team -> Role bindings -> search group -> reassign).
- Infra-side quick fix: run a one-off remap to update role_bindings.external_id to lower-case for this org or to the Okta-provided value. We'll prefer a targeted remap to avoid accidental mass changes.

Maria: Customer wants a safe script we can run for them. Do we have a vetted command?

Sam: Provide the API-based remap (preferred over direct DB write). Example (internal admin API):
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/role-bindings/remap" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer admin_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"brightwave-123","from_external_id":"Engineers","to_external_id":"engineers"}'
```
This will atomically update bindings and re-evaluate cached memberships. Use rate-limit header to avoid overload.

Priya: I've queued the remap job for org brightwave-123 now (targeted). Job id: remap-20260310-778. ETA ~30m. Noted a few throttling warnings during initial dry-run but it's scoped so should be fine.

Maria: I'll reply to the customer with the workaround (rebind via console or we run remap). Ask them to hold off on further bulk SCIM renames until we finish.

Ali: Customer approved us running the remap. I'll notify once we have confirmation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Remap job completed at 2026-03-10T12:28:05Z. Post-check: bindings now show external_id = "engineers" and users who are members of that Okta group have project.admin.

Maria: Customer confirmed UI buttons are back and edits succeed. Closing the support case. :tada:

Sam: Follow-up action: add a detection rule in the SCIM sync service to warn when external_id normalization changes existing external_ids (flag potential RBAC drift). Filed issue INF-1938.

Ali: Noted. I'll include the workaround in the KB article for SCIM group rename gotchas. :eyes:
